title: Firecrawl scrape and search
description: Scrape a URL to clean markdown and run web searches through a self-hosted Firecrawl instance. Ships an optional bearer-token reverse-proxy gateway for operators who must expose the otherwise unauthenticated Firecrawl API beyond loopback.

baseUrl.description: Firecrawl API base URL without a trailing slash. Point this at the token gateway URL when using the deploy/ template.

tokenFile.description: Path to a file holding the bearer token (0600). Empty string sends no Authorization header (loopback-only deployments).

maxMarkdownBytes.description: Upper bound in UTF-8 bytes for the markdown returned by firecrawl.scrape. Larger documents are truncated and flagged.

capabilities.title: Scrape a URL to markdown
capabilities.description: Fetch one public URL through the configured Firecrawl instance and return clean markdown (optionally main content only). The response is bounded by maxMarkdownBytes.

onlyMainContent.description: Ask Firecrawl to drop navigation, footers and other boilerplate.

capabilities.title: Search the web through Firecrawl
capabilities.description: Run a web search through the configured Firecrawl instance and return titles, URLs and descriptions. Upstream failures are reported as ok:false JSON instead of crashing the shell capability.

checks.description: python syntax of the scrape/search executors and the gateway template
